aiMetadata.description: Checks the deliverability of a single email address via NeverBounce, returning a verification result (e.g. valid, invalid, disposable, catch-all) so an agent can decide whether to keep, flag, or discard the address before sending. Use for one-off real-time validation of a single recipient; for large lists use a bulk/list-verification flow instead. Requires the email address as input. Read-only and idempotent: re-running with the same address does not change anything.
